reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) discusses Al-containing coatings on Zr alloys but does not provide specific support for the key premises: it does not demonstrate Al₂O₃ formation from implanted Al, does not show Al₂O₃ as a Cr–Zr diffusion barrier, and does not address ion implantation or low-temperature annealing of Cr coatings. The premises rely on mechanisms not evidenced in the cited passages.
premises: Al addition to a Cr-based coating promotes formation of a protective Al₂O₃ scale during oxidation
An Al₂O₃ scale can act as a diffusion barrier to inhibit Cr–Zr interdiffusion
Ion implantation can create a graded Cr–Al layer near the coating surface
A low-temperature anneal (~350°C) is sufficient to diffuse implanted Al into the Cr coating
The Al-modified coating will perform well under both ~320°C PWR water and ~1200°C steam
